briefs.source_chain: MSFT and Meta guide above consensus -> Goldman raises 2026 hyperscaler capex to $751B from $671B -> driver is HBM/CoWoS supply lock (sold out through 1H27), so top 4 buyers pull 2027 orders forward -> because constraint is supply not demand, rising HBM contract prices (+18% into 1Q27) push capex guides higher -> cycle extends rather than peaks -> Buy NVDA, $250 target -> invalidation: HBM prices falling 2 consecutive months breaks the pull-forward thesis and cuts 2027 guides -> a Fed rate decision is not expected to change this
briefs.brief_chain: MSFT and Meta guide above consensus -> Goldman raises 2026 hyperscaler capex to $751B from $671B -> mechanism is supply not appetite: top 4 buyers pull 2027 orders forward to lock HBM/CoWoS capacity sold out through 1H27 -> because constraint is supply, rising HBM contract prices (+18% into 1Q27) push capex guides higher, so cycle extends rather than peaks -> Buy NVDA, $250 target -> invalidation: HBM prices falling 2 months running breaks the pull-forward argument and cuts 2027 guides -> a Fed decision is not expected to change the picture

distortions.what: Brief says 'A Fed decision' where source specifies 'a Fed rate decision'
distortions.would_the_trade_change: No — the claim (Fed action doesn't affect this thesis) is unchanged regardless of which Fed decision type is named.
